propositions: Model-tiering gradient (strong/standard/cheap tier table and per-dispatch tier-naming rules) adds complexity without sufficient token savings on wide epics and should be removed from SKILL.md.
Phase 0 currently hard-stops on tickets with no children, but childless story/task with recorded file impact is an executable code leaf and should run as a single leaf instead of being refused.
Held-out discipline (implementer as separate subagent) must be preserved throughout removal of tiering language from Phases 3, 4a, 4d, and rewrite of Phase 4e-bis.
Phase 0 must recognize two executable shapes: tickets with children (tree) and childless story/task with non-empty `rebar get-file-impact` output (single leaf), stopping only when neither holds.
Frontmatter description, Phase 0 heading, Phase 2 callout, and Reporting section must all remain consistent with both removal and childless-leaf-execution changes.
